status: PARTIAL — frozen engineering items only. Biology items (01-04) BLOCKED.
purpose: Allow external lab to validate the FROZEN ENGINEERING PORTION of P-04 (flow range, contact-time equation, drainage floor, pulsation sync mechanism) WITHOUT the blocked biology items.
what_can_be_validated_now: Pulsation synchronization mechanism — does phase-locked valve modulation produce 1.3-1.5x effective contact time vs unsynchronized?
Drainage floor enforcement — does fail-safe bypass engage correctly when Q drops below 0.10 mL/min?
Flow range operation — does system maintain 0.30 mL/min total drainage across pulsation cycle?
Contact time equation — does tau = V/Q match measurement, and does clearance scale as predicted?
what_CANNOT_be_validated_now: Actual Aβ clearance rate — requires working enzyme membrane
Chronic stability — requires months-long in vitro test
honest_disclosure: An external lab cannot fully validate P-04 today. They can validate the engineering skeleton (pulsation sync, drainage floor, flow control) using a NON-ENZYMATIC membrane. To validate the full P-04, the enzyme engineering program (items 01-04) must be completed first. Estimated 6-12 months of biology work.
what_external_lab_should_do_instead: 1. Build bench-top flow loop with non-enzymatic membrane (e.g., dyed cellulose to simulate enzyme)
2. Validate pulsation synchronization: measure effective contact time with vs without sync
3. Validate drainage floor: induce membrane occlusion, verify fail-safe bypass engages correctly
4. Validate flow range: confirm 0.30 mL/min maintained across pulsation cycle
6. ONCE enzyme engineering program completes: re-validate with enzymatic membrane using the same protocol
